newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela's farm-out oil output rising sharply.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela's farm-out oil output rising sharply.

text.p: Lagoven, one of Venezuela's three big state oil subsidiaries, said crude oil production from five oilfields operated by private companies would rise by 55,000 barrel per day (bpd) this year to 117,000 bpd.

Average levels of production this year were expected to be 18,000 bpd in the BP operated Pedernales, 30,000 bpd in Shell operated Urdaneta West, 48,000 bpd in Benton -Vinccler operated Uracoa/Bombal/Tucupita, 19,000 bpd in Total /Amoco operated Jusepin and 2,000 bpd in Maxus /BP /Otepi operated Quiriquire.
Lagoven has farmed out production of the fields to private firms in exchange for a fixed operators fee.
The third such licensing round, with 20 fields on offer, is due to take place next week in Caracas.
